Various genomic and cellular changes in hypoxia adaptations (by Figdraw)

Various genomic and cellular changes in hypoxia adaptations (by Figdraw). a Summary diagram of HIF-1 signaling pathway. HIF, a transcription factor coordinating the cellular response to hypoxia, can be activated by the MAPK and PI3K-Akt signaling pathways. HIF regulates target genes expression to increase oxygen delivery and reduce oxygen consumption. b Diagram categorizing rapidly evolving, accelerated conserved noncoding element related, and highly expressed genes in the deep-diving group according to their functions, with rapidly evolving genes highlighted in green background, accelerated conserved noncoding element-related genes in orange background, and upregulated genes in red background. G1P, glucose 1-phosphate; G6P, glucose 6-phosphate; LDL, low-density lipoprotein. c Different tissue responses to hypoxia. Refer to the enrichment results (Additional file 1: Table S19)
